title: CBD Repair Over T-tube or Primary Repair
brief_summary: the aim is to assess the benefits and harms of T-tube drainage versus primary closure without biliary stent after exploration common bile duct stones
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who will undergo common bile duct exploration

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients who has failed ERCP for management of common bile duct exploration
* CBD diameter 2 cm or more
study_population: patient who will undergo CBD exploration for management of CBD stone
